Viewer libraries, kept here (not loaded from a CDN) so manuals and 3D files
open with no connection.

pdfjs/   PDF.js 3.11.174, Mozilla Foundation, Apache License 2.0 (pdfjs/LICENSE)
         https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
three/   three.js r160 (three.module.min.js, STLLoader.js, OrbitControls.js),
         three.js authors, MIT License (three/LICENSE)  https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js
